A delicious evening in Nha Trang (and not alone)!
Feb 2026 • Friends
Accidentally, we wandered into this magical place! And our guts didn't let us down! A gorgeous and uninflated menu with delicious dishes! An institution with a soul! This is where you can taste the most delicious ostrich steak, and strawberry tuna tartare is a masterpiece! Special thanks to the lovely girl Vera, who welcomed us as family and her partner (unfortunately, the Vietnamese boy's name was not recognized). And even if you have to wait a little while for a table to be available, trust me, it's worth it! We'll come back again!
P.S. If you don't order SALAMI CHOCOLATE for dessert, never forgive yourself!

Not for tuna, but for ostrich.
Apr 2025 • Couples
Saw the rails, let's go check:

- Strawberry tartare with tuna unusual combination
Niçoise salad, the serving is much more chic than the taste. Either there was too much tuna in a day after tartare.
Ostrich. It's a fabulous dish. The ostrich resembles a tender steak.

Drinking mojitos from maracuya, the taste of alcohol imperceptible from the word "at all."

The restaurant itself is not on the main street, but in a turnpike where mopeds ride and local insect fauna walk. One of those reps with a mustache I walked my foot out of the restaurant. It's a little sultry inside because there's no entrance area with a door.
